name: Margaretha
bioAdditions: FamilySearch does not have a Margaretha as wife of Christmann Grub: it names his wife (mother of Veltes 1615 and Caspar 1616) as 'Elssa', born 11 Apr 1597, with no source beyond a marriage index entry (S1). The site's Margaretha is therefore unsupported by the tree that the site's Grub line otherwise follows; her name needs the Niederbrombach baptism of Caspar (26 May 1616), which should name the mother.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Name conflicts with the only tree found; no record seen.

sources.citation: FamilySearch published tree, Elssa (G9MF-6ML), wife of Christmann Grub
